scripts.build: bun run build:runtime && bun --bun run nuxt build
scripts.build:node: bun run build:runtime && NITRO_PRESET=node-server bun --bun run nuxt build
scripts.build:bun: bun run build:runtime && NITRO_PRESET=bun bun --bun run nuxt build
scripts.build:cloudflare: bun run build:runtime && NITRO_PRESET=cloudflare_module bun --bun run nuxt build
scripts.build:vercel: bun run build:runtime && NITRO_PRESET=vercel bun --bun run nuxt build
scripts.deploy:b2: bun run build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.b2.jsonc
scripts.dev: bun run build:runtime && bun --bun run nuxt dev --port 6969 --host 127.0.0.1

scripts.test:bundle: bun run build && bun test --timeout 30000 tests/bundle-api.test.mjs
scripts.test:local-runtime: bun run build && bun test --timeout 30000 tests/local-runtime.test.mjs

scripts.test:cloudflare-runtime: bun run build:cloudflare && bun test --timeout 30000 tests/cloudflare-runtime.test.mjs

ADMIN_USERNAME.description: Owner login name for this Serangkai instance.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Owner password. Choose a strong value; it is stored as a scrypt hash.

JWT_SECRET.description: Stable root secret for browser sessions. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

SHARE_SECRET.description: Different stable secret for signed share links. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

NUXT_APP_SECRET.description: Stable session-sealing key for Workers. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`; it must not change between deploys.
